- The TLS certificate for `go.octolab.org` has subject and SAN `go.octolab.org`,
  valid until 2026-12-18.
- `GOPROXY=direct GOSUMDB=sum.golang.org go mod download` with an empty module
  cache succeeded for `go.octolab.org@v0.12.0`, `go.octolab.org@v0.12.2` and

  tag `v0.0.5`, while `proxy.golang.org` still lists `v0.0.1`–`v0.0.5`.
- The same direct download succeeded for every `go.octolab.org` version in
  today's module graph (`go.mod:12-14`): `go.octolab.org@v0.12.0`,
  `go.octolab.org@v0.12.2`, `toolkit/cli@v0.6.4`, `toolkit/config@v0.0.5`.
- The latest 30 `Continuous integration` runs contain no failure; the last
  `Workflow caches warmup` run (2026-09-22) passed.
- Not run: a cold warmup on both Go versions after the latest `go.sum` change,
  or a release on split runners.
